title: Serious Violation Step-Down and Stock Removed from Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN)
content:
How much of a serious violation's points steps down under Seller Performance Standing depends on what the seller has done with stock in the Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) network.

**Stock rule.** For a seller whose enrollment billed a disposal removal fee in the last six whole calendar months all the carried points come off at the step-down; for a seller whose enrollment billed no disposal removal fee but a return-to-seller removal fee in that period the share-applied points come off together with one quarter of the carried points left after them, rounded down to a whole point; for every other seller the share-applied points come off.

## The records read

Removal fee entries billed on the seller's Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) enrollment, each with its removal type — disposal or return to seller — and its billing date. A fee lies in the last six whole calendar months when fewer than six whole months have passed from its billing date to the handling date, counted by calendar date.

## Decision table

| Disposal removal fee in the period | Return-to-seller removal fee in the period | Points that step down |
|---|---|---|
| one or more | any | all the carried points |
| none | one or more | the share-applied points, plus one quarter of (the carried points less the share-applied points), that quarter rounded down to a whole point |
| none | none | the share-applied points |

"Carried points" are the serious-violation points carried at the step-down; "share-applied points" are the carried points after the step-down share has been applied and rounded down to a whole point.

## Worked figures (hypothetical: carried points 9, share-applied points 1)

- Disposal fee billed four months ago: 9 points step down.
- Return-to-seller fee billed two months ago, no disposal fee: 9 less 1 leaves 8; one quarter of 8 is 2; 1 plus 2 gives 3 points.
- Only a disposal fee billed eight whole months ago: it is outside the period, and with no other fee the share-applied 1 point steps down.

With carried points 11 and share-applied points 2 under the return-to-seller tier: 11 less 2 leaves 9; one quarter of 9 is 2.25, rounded down to 2; 2 plus 2 gives 4.
